name: How does communication usually work during a design-build project?

mainEntity.name: How does communication usually work during a design-build project?
mainEntity.text: How does communication usually work during a design-build project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Communication can make or break a design-build experience. The best firms assign a clear point of contact who can coordinate design questions, field issues, selections, and schedule updates. Homeowners should expect regular check-ins, written summaries of decisions, and a consistent approval process for changes. In luxury projects, communication is especially important because finish choices, custom details, and client preferences often evolve during the job. Ask how often updates are provided, whether there is a client portal or scheduled meeting cadence, and how emergencies are handled. The ideal system is simple, documented, and responsive. If the communication structure is unclear before the project begins, confusion usually increases once construction is underway.
acceptedAnswer.description: Communication usually happens through a project manager, designer, or lead contact who coordinates updates, approvals, and schedule changes. The best firms use regular check-ins, documented decisions, and clear change order procedures so the homeowner always knows status and next steps.
